payload.title: M3 Publish: Facebook adapter and scheduling (#3)
payload.objective: Manually written posts approved by a human are published to Facebook at their scheduled minute through an idempotent job.
successCriteria: Facebook adapter with connect flow and Page selection
Channels with encrypted tokens and expiry
Posts and variants with the brief's state machine; only humans approve
Scheduler dispatches due posts every minute
Idempotent PublishPostJob with per-variant lock and external_id check
Test proves double dispatch never makes two platform calls
Isolation tests for every new model
Graph API tests use Http::fake fixtures
Approved post goes out at its scheduled minute and shows its permalink
